create_tf_dataset: create a tf.data.Dataset from a TFRecord file containing protein contact features
parse_tfexample: parse a serialized tf.Example proto and return reshaped protein feature tensors
normalize_features: normalize protein features using standard deviation statistics from a JSON stats file
convert_to_legacy_format: convert tf.Dataset output to the legacy ProteinDescription namedtuple format with 1D and 2D inputs
get_feature_shape: get the concrete tensor shape for a named protein feature given the number of residues
